text: SUPERVISOR — third in your queue (after PLACEFREEZE and AUTHBUILD-REMOVE): PREFABSELECT-0606. User verbatim: "there is a prefab method inside of the new build tool, but i dont see any obvious way to switch to the tool that lets me select which parts go together in a prefab, and i know i had asked about it earlier though it might have never got done anyways" — confirmed never done (predates the request ledger; the piece list shows a "0 Prefabs" category with no way to author one). Build the missing half: a SELECT tool in build mode — the user selects placed pieces (click/click-drag multi-select with clear visual marking), groups the selection into a named prefab, and it appears under the Prefabs category for placement like any other piece (placing a prefab stamps all its parts with their relative offsets, snapping to the same lattice). Survey first: how the Prefabs category is currently wired (something put that slot there — find what exists vs what is missing, post it before building). Respect the build-tool conventions on selection visuals and the three chrome laws; prefab placement composes with everything placement already does (yaw, anchor, validation) — no special-case path. Storage: prefabs persist the V20 way, scoped per the owner-map rules. Tests at the consumption layer: select N pieces -> save prefab -> place it on a clear area -> identical relative layout; plus a Zig-side test if any Zig logic changes. DONE-BAR: survey posted, then the working tool + tests + verify green + READY. DO NOT COMMIT. The user authoring and stamping a prefab is the PASS.
